system.name: OralGPT-Omni (TRACE-CoT, MMOral-Uni)
system.one_liner: A dental-specialised multimodal LLM trained on a multi-modality dental corpus with clinician-style chain-of-thought data, plus a unified dental benchmark.

content.variant_note: a gallery of eight dental modalities, a worked reasoning example with tagged answer, and a bar chart of the training data
content.argues: One model covers eight dental imaging modalities, answers with a clinician-like five-step reasoning pattern, and is trained on a corpus whose composition is shown.
content.subject: Eight dental modalities as example cards, one tagged chain-of-thought answer to a periapical X-ray question, and corpus sizes with a bar chart.

lessons.what_to_learn: Number the abstract reasoning steps in a dashed list, highlight each in the colour of its tag in a real response and tie them with grey arrows; pair this with a gallery of dashed modality cards and a sorted bar chart so coverage, example and statistics share one figure.
lessons.suits: Domain-specific MLLM or dataset papers in medicine or science that must show data types, a reasoning format and corpus statistics together.

evidence: Caption: (a) eight dental imaging modalities, (b) the TRACE-CoT reasoning pattern, (c) composition of the training corpus with a modality bar chart.
Introduction: TRACE-CoT mirrors radiologists' diagnostic decision-making, shown in Figure 1(b).
Section 2: the curated corpus covers eight modalities, from intraoral photos and videos to 3D scans and interleaved image-text data.

summary: OralGPT-Omni is a dental-specialised multimodal LLM trained on a corpus of eight dental imaging modalities with chain-of-thought data that mimics a clinician's reasoning. Figure 1 shows the corpus in three parts. Panel (a), inside a black frame, is a gallery of dashed cards numbered i to viii: intraoral photos, panoramic, periapical and cephalometric X-rays, histopathology slides, an image-text treatment-planning record, a film strip of treatment video and a 3D scan. Panel (b) follows one X-ray question through the five TRACE-CoT steps, colour-matched to the Caption, Think and Answer tags of the response. Panel (c) lists the corpus sizes above a sorted bar chart of instances per modality.
